because the recorded strength is the peak over a passage's tokens, any running text containing one ordinary content noun is predicted active (70% of 2-token, 81% of 3-token, 91% of 5-token and 99.9% of 32-token spans of the scan corpus are), while predicted inactive are lone tokens, 2-4-token phrases built only from the zero-key words above (' his own time ', ' my left hand ', ' these four places ', ' those three men '), and phrases whose only content word is a deep-key route word (' the road '), with the caveat that the first two or three positions of a short prompt lower z by about 0.05-0.3 relative to running text, so a function word there can still fire (the second token of ' her two large ' is 0.08, the second token of ' salt and sugar ' is 0.16).
